widgets_values: Dress the green area in this short-sleeved knit shirt, primarily dark blue in color, with white horizontal stripes. The stripes are evenly spaced, and the white stripes indeed have a wave-like irregular pattern. Each white stripe is not completely straight, creating a neat pattern. The collar features a reddish-brown ribbed round neck design, adding visual contrast and depth. On the left chest, there is a small white embroidered Polo logo.

Dress the naked woman in this short-sleeved knit shirt, primarily dark blue in color, with white horizontal stripes. The stripes are evenly spaced, forming a neat pattern. The collar features a dark red ribbed design, adding visual contrast and depth. On the left chest, there is a small white embroidered brand logo pattern.
